__NOTOC__ {{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=10–12|time=Prep: 10 minutes
Cooking: ~30 minutes|difficulty=3 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the Netherlands|Dutch Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]] This is an old [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the Netherlands|Dutch]] recipe for a very 'powerful' chocolate pie. == Ingredients == === Filling === * 150–200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]] * 150–200 g white[[Cookbook:Granulated_Sugar| granulated sugar]] * 250–500 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] * About 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] (optional) === Crust === * 2–3 packs of 'marie' [[Cookbook:Cookie|biscuits]] (also known as 'rich tea' biscuits) * Cold brewed black [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]] or other taste makers (optional) === Topping === * Chocolate [[Cookbook:Sprinkles|sprinkles]] == Special equipment == * Dish or mold with high sides (e.g. [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform]] or [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]]; about 26 [[Cookbook:cm|cm]] in diameter) * [[Cookbook:Saucepan|Saucepan]] * [[Cookbook:Wooden_Spoon|Wooden spoon]] == Procedure == # Melt the butter in a saucepan, then mix in the sugar. # Stir in the cocoa and milk. # Dip biscuits in the coffee, and arrange them in the bottom of the dish to make a single layer. Spread the chocolate mixture on top of the biscuits. Repeat this step until you run out of biscuits and chocolate. # Scatter the sprinkles on top, then chill in the fridge until set. # Slice and serve. == Notes, tips, and variations == * The above measurements aren't precise; play with the amounts to your liking. * Adding the milk will make the cake less solid. * Coffee is optional; addition is to taste. * Use about 750 g butter for more than 2 layers of biscuits, and adjust the cocoa/sugar to match. * Vegan variation: Remove the milk and chocolate sprinkles, and replace the butter by ⅔ [[Cookbook:Soy|soy]] butter and ⅓ [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] (or all margarine). [[Category:Vegan recipes|{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert|{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Recipes for pies and tarts|{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Dutch recipes|{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using cocoa powder]] [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using brewed coffee]] [[Category:Recipes using cow milk]] [[Category:Recipes using cookies]]
